name: staff-of-blossoming-will-enter-draw-and-flowerbud
notes: Staff of Blossoming Will (4moumzcx9z, TERA REGALIA/ITEM, CLERIC): (1) On Enter -- draw a card (enterAbilities['4moumzcx9z:0'], GeneratedMacroCode.php:9648, a plain Draw(player,1)). (2) [Diao Chan Bonus] (1), [REST]: Target player summons a Flowerbud token (activateAbilityAbilities['4moumzcx9z:0']:2035, gated by activateAbilityPrereqs['4moumzcx9z:0']:2047 requiring IsDiaoChanBonus($player) + source awake + a CHAMPION on either field; customDQHandlers['4moumzcx9z:0:ActivateAbility-1']:27077 resolves the chosen champion's mzID to its controller and adds a Flowerbud (yn78t73w1p) to THAT player's own field). myField-0's Subcards are patched to include Diao Chan, Idyll Corsage (d7l6i5thdy, TERA element) -- this grants TERA element access via lineage (needed to legally play a TERA card) AND independently satisfies IsDiaoChanBonus (checks ChampionHasInLineage for any of the 3 Diao Chan card IDs) in one patch; patchMzId never triggers Enter(), so Idyll Corsage's own On Enter/passive never fires. ENGINE BEHAVIOR NOTE (not a bug, but non-obvious, documented for future authors): REGALIA-type cards cannot be seeded directly into myHand via the normal setup zone-add primitive -- HandAddReplacement (Custom/GameLogic.php:17777) unconditionally redirects any card whose CardType contains REGALIA into myMaterial instead, confirmed empirically (the setup log's reported mzID is also mislabeled 'myHand-N' in this case even though the object actually landed in Material). Also, seeding a card that owns an $enterAbilities entry directly onto myField via setup DOES synchronously fire its Enter() (FieldAfterAdd calls FinalizeFieldEntryEnter unconditionally at the end), which would bake the draw into the initial snapshot and make it invisible as an actions-replay delta. Both obstacles are avoided by patching myHand-6 (the last opening-hand slot) directly to Staff of Blossoming Will's own CardID via patchMzId -- this mutates an object already in the hand array, bypassing HandAddReplacement entirely (it never calls AddHand()) -- then playing it for real via a normal mode 10002 FSM click, so the On Enter draw is a genuine, observable action-driven event (deck 13->12). The REST ability is then activated and its (1) reserve is paid, and theirField-0 (the opponent's champion) is chosen as the target -- the Flowerbud lands on player 2's field (p2Field-1), proving the token goes to the TARGETED player, not always the activator.

rulesClauses: [Diao Chan Bonus] (1), [REST]: Target player summons a Flowerbud token.
